# Vej

> Vej is a 2B text model you run yourself that returns native probabilities over developer-supplied outcomes. It provides native distributions without text generation, JSON parsing, or hosted APIs. Apache-2.0 code and adaptations, research alpha, text only.

## Key Facts
- Three primitives: Choice (pick among named options), Noul (assess statement truth as true/false), Score (rate rubric levels with expectation computed in caller code).
- Architecture: Frozen BF16 Qwen3.5-2B text backbone, rank-16 alpha-32 LoRA adapters, and a trained FP32 scalar decision head (~16.82M trainable parameters).
- Checkpoint: Full native state dict of ~3.6 GiB. Runs on a single 16 GB GPU or CPU fallback. Repeated state encoding; stock vLLM is not supported.
- Test performance: 76.60% exact accuracy overall across 14,286 frozen test decisions (Choice 89.22%, Noul 91.71%, Score 51.62%).
- Hosted Jev comparison: Hosted Jev 1.13 scored 71.76% overall on the same test rows with documented rounding adjustment. Jev returned 99.31% strict format validity.
- Availability: Checkpoint is hosted privately on Hugging Face (Kennes/vej-qwen-2b-alpha2) for authorized account members. Core development repository is private.
- Licensing: Vej code and model adaptations are Apache-2.0. Qwen base model and original datasets retain their respective terms.

## Primary Pages
- [Overview](https://lodekennes.github.io/vej-site/): Value proposition, three-step integration, benchmark summary, use cases, and FAQ.
- [Evaluation](https://lodekennes.github.io/vej-site/evaluation.html): Ten training sources, split protocol, held-out accuracy, same-test Jev comparison, and SHA256 hashes.
- [Model card](https://lodekennes.github.io/vej-site/model.html): Architecture, private availability, verbatim local inference CLI commands, vLLM status, and limits.
- [Licenses](https://lodekennes.github.io/vej-site/licenses.html): Attribution and terms for code, Qwen base model, training datasets, and bundled fonts.
- [Brand](https://lodekennes.github.io/vej-site/brand.html): The Open Pod visual identity, color schemes, and vector assets.

## Aggregate Evidence Files
- [evaluation.json](https://lodekennes.github.io/vej-site/evidence/evaluation.json): Full metrics, slice breakdowns, and reliability bins across all 14,286 test decisions.
- [jev-comparison.json](https://lodekennes.github.io/vej-site/evidence/jev-comparison.json): Same-test aggregate comparison between Vej alpha2 and hosted Jev 1.13, including strict and adjusted metrics.
- [tool-evaluation.json](https://lodekennes.github.io/vej-site/evidence/tool-evaluation.json): Diagnostic results on workflow actions and tool call readiness.
- [descriptive-controls.json](https://lodekennes.github.io/vej-site/evidence/descriptive-controls.json): Post-hoc majority and descriptive baseline controls.
- [DATA_SOURCES.md](https://lodekennes.github.io/vej-site/evidence/DATA_SOURCES.md): Publisher sources, split allocations, and original license notices.
- [DATASET_CARD.md](https://lodekennes.github.io/vej-site/evidence/DATASET_CARD.md): Dataset composition, selection rules, and filtering criteria.

## Operational Boundaries (Not Claimed)
- Not production-ready: Research alpha with limited tool diagnostic reliability (30/48 harder cases passed) and weak Score accuracy (51.62%).
- No calibrated risk: Descriptive probabilities are not guarantees of correctness or authorization to execute tools.
- No speed claim: Inference uses repeated state encoding; latency and serving speed advantages have not been measured.
- No hosted API: Inference runs locally on user-managed infrastructure.
